content.text:
{"dialogue": "Maya: okay that baking show is unhinged
Maya: someone just made a cake that looks like a mop
Me: lol nooo why a mop
Maya: idk art or whatever, judges are confused too
Me: send me the name after, need something dumb to watch
Maya: yes will do, perfect couch background
Maya: did you ever get off the couch btw
Me: nope still in blanket mode
Me: might order in later honestly
Maya: same, pasta leftovers are gone so idk what dinner is
Me: i had cereal yesterday, might do it again
Maya: iconic adult dinner
Me: right?
Maya: oh my face mask plan failed, too lazy to get up
Me: keep rotting, mask can wait
Maya: exactly
Maya: hey so are we doing lunch again this week?
Me: yes please, need something to look forward to
Maya: pizza again? im still thinking about Rosa's
Me: always down for pizza
Maya: Rosa's on Oak Street on Friday?
Me: yeah that place never misses
Maya: their garlic knots are still calling me
Me: seriously, i dream about them
Maya: lol same
Maya: would 12:30 work for you?
Me: yeah that works for me
Maya: perfect, pizza Friday at 12:30 then
Me: cant wait, i need a proper lunch break
Maya: are you in office that day?
Me: yeah but i can slip out, same as last time
Maya: nice, like an hour or so?
Me: yeah probably an hour, hour and a half
Maya: plenty of time
Maya: patio again if the weather is good?
Me: yes, way better since they redid it
Maya: and less scary chairs
Me: i will still do a safety test for you
Maya: please do, appreciate the service
Me: should i get knots to start again?
Maya: omg yes, half order so we still have room
Me: half order, got it
Maya: you know the drill now
Me: expert pizza friend
Maya: lol exactly
Maya: hows your wavy bowl key holder doing
Me: still holding keys, still wavy
Maya: functional art
Me: did your sister ever look at pottery again?
Maya: no she keeps saying someday, classic
Me: tell her tuesday guy says hi lol
Maya: i will, he sounds chill
Me: messy but fun, you should come once
Maya: maybe in october with her?
Me: yes do it, we can all be lopsided together
Maya: im so bad at crafts tho
Me: thats the charm, trust
Maya: if you say so
Maya: oh also basil update, still alive
Me: no way, miracle plant
Maya: dont jinx it, it can sense doubt
Me: sending good sun vibes
Maya: it needs it, my kitchen is dark
Me: mine too, my other plants are barely hanging on
Maya: you watered them tho right
Me: yeah last week, need to again soon
Maya: plant parent duties never end
Me: true
Maya: okay im finally getting up, need real food
Me: same, cereal round two incoming
Maya: enjoy, see you friday at Rosa's?
Me: yes, 12:30, knots first", "writer_note": "Kept the evening couch-rot voice from prior Sundays while weaving the Friday pizza plan into casual chatter about food, pottery, and plants, with a clear proposal of Rosa's on Oak Street at 12:30 and a short acceptance."}
